scripts.avatar_brief: Woman 55-65, silver or greying hair worn naturally, no makeup, bare-faced in a bathroom with a window behind her so the light is flat and unflattering. Delivery is dry and unhurried, like she is talking to one friend, not a camera.
scripts.hook: This is my skin at 8am in the worst light in my house. No filter, no makeup.
scripts.first_frame: Extreme close-up on the outer corner of her eye and cheek, harsh window light raking across so texture and lines read clearly. No product in frame.

beats.vo: This is my skin at 8am in the worst light in my house. No filter, no makeup.
beats.visual: Macro on eye corner and cheek in flat window light. Slow push in.

beats.vo: I stopped hiding from this mirror about a year ago.
beats.visual: She leans back, we see her full face for the first time, still bare.

beats.vo: Most nights now I use one thing. It's a beeswax balm, rosehip and marigold, and it works overnight while you sleep.
beats.visual: She scoops the night balm with two fingers. Product name clearly legible on the jar.

beats.vo: It's thick. It doesn't disappear in ten seconds like the light lotions I kept buying.
beats.visual: Close on the balm warming between her fingertips, stretching.

beats.vo: It supports the skin barrier in 7 days, and it softens the look of fine lines. That's it. That's the whole claim.
beats.visual: She presses it into the same cheek from the opening frame.

beats.vo: I'm not going to tell you it made me 40 again. I'm telling you I stopped avoiding this light.
beats.visual: Same harsh window light, same angle as the first frame, now with balm on.

beats.vo: Frøya's Wrinkle Smoothing Night Balm. Thirty-seven dollars. Link's here.
beats.visual: Jar held at chest height, site name on screen.

scripts.cta: Frøya's Wrinkle Smoothing Night Balm. Thirty-seven dollars. Link's here.

scripts.avatar_brief: Woman 48-58, dressed for work, filming in a parked car with the visor mirror down — daylight is brutal and she is clearly not in a studio. Delivery is fast, slightly irritated, venting between errands.
scripts.hook: Car mirror. Midday sun. This is the lighting that tells the truth about under-eyes.
scripts.first_frame: Phone held at arm's length in a car, visor mirror down, direct sun on the left side of her face. Under-eye shadow and puffiness clearly visible.

beats.vo: Car mirror. Midday sun. This is the lighting that tells the truth about under-eyes.
beats.visual: Handheld in-car selfie framing, harsh sun, no colour grading.

beats.vo: I've spent more on eye creams than I want to say out loud.
beats.visual: She tilts her face toward the sun, deliberately showing the area.

beats.vo: This one is an arctic arnica beeswax balm. It has 6 of the 10 top anti-age ingredients.
beats.visual: Small jar pulled from her bag, held near her face so scale reads.

beats.vo: Looks less puffy in 4 to 9 days. That's the number they give, so that's the number I'm giving you.
beats.visual: Ring-finger tap along the orbital bone, unglamorous and quick.

beats.vo: It's fifty-two dollars, which I did wince at. I'm on my second jar.
beats.visual: She caps the jar, drops it back in her bag.

beats.vo: Magic Revive Eye Balm, from Frøya. Go look at it in bad lighting first.
beats.visual: Product on the passenger seat, brand name on screen.

scripts.cta: Magic Revive Eye Balm, from Frøya. Go look at it in bad lighting first.

scripts.product: The Complete System for Mature Women's Skin ($121.07)
scripts.avatar_brief: Woman 60-70, at a kitchen table early morning, dressing gown, tea going cold. Overhead kitchen light only — the least flattering source in a house. Delivery is warm and conversational, mid-thought, no performance energy.
scripts.hook: Overhead kitchen light. Nobody films themselves in overhead kitchen light.
scripts.first_frame: Phone propped against something on a kitchen table, framing her face from slightly below under a single overhead bulb. Shadows fall badly under the eyes and nose.

beats.vo: Overhead kitchen light. Nobody films themselves in overhead kitchen light.
beats.visual: Static propped shot, overhead bulb, unretouched skin.

beats.vo: I did it on purpose. You should see what you're actually buying into.
beats.visual: She shrugs, turns her face slowly left then right under the light.

beats.vo: Four steps, wild-harvested Arctic plants. Cleanse, day balm, eye balm, night balm.
beats.visual: She sets the four jars down in order, one at a time, on the table.

beats.vo: It's a hundred and twenty-one dollars for the set, which is a real amount of money.
beats.visual: Overhead shot of the four jars in a row.

beats.vo: What I can tell you is 95% reported youthful glow, and 823,000 women have bought into this.
beats.visual: Back to her face, same bad light, applying the day balm.

beats.vo: Decide in your own worst lighting. That's all I did.
beats.visual: She picks up the cold tea, shot holds on the four jars.

beats.vo: The Complete System for Mature Women's Skin, at Frøya.
beats.visual: Brand name and site on screen over the kitchen table.

scripts.cta: The Complete System for Mature Women's Skin, at Frøya.
